text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original chibi animated barista companion voice. Light youthful masculine tenor, small bright rounded resonance, a warm little smile, gently bouncy musical phrasing. Cozy and softly playful, like a friendly miniature cartoon cafe helper. Clear relaxed conversational speech. Avoid low chest resonance, baritone, mature announcer delivery, whispering or shouting.
